title: Pakistan Army Chief Arrives in Tehran to Mediate Iran-Israel War
detail: Pakistan Army Chief General Asim Munir arrived in Tehran for high-level mediation talks aimed at ending the Iran-Israel war — the highest-level Pakistani diplomatic visit as part of an active mediation effort. Pakistan has positioned itself as a key neutral interlocutor between Iran and Israel, leveraging its ties with both the Muslim world and Western partners.

media.caption: Pakistan Army Chief General Asim Munir arrives in Tehran for mediation talks
